Groups and Rentals
services.desc: Whether you’re looking for a hilarious private show or workshop for your business, a work holiday party, an engaging school outing, or an custom improv show tailored to your group’s sense of humour, we’ve got you covered! Our shows are designed to elevate your gatherings, spark joy, and leave a smile on everyone’s faces. You can choose to host a show at your venue within Greater Vancouver and create a familiar and comfortable atmosphere for your guests, or really go for it and rent our fully equipped bar, lounge, and theatre for your next conference or event. Bring your work group to The Improv Centre for all kinds of work parties and events, including Holiday Parties, Team-Building Events,

services.name: Venue Rentals
services.desc: Our theatre holds up to 186 guests - 48 cabaret seats, 18 bench seats & 120 theatre-style seats. We have audio-visual capabilities including a raised stage, projector, full audio switchboard, mics and lighting operated by our professional technicians. Accessible seating available! The Improv Centre’s patio is located right on the False Creek Marina, covered and available to include in your rental! With gratitude we acknowledge that our theatre and its offices are situated on the traditional, ancestral, and unceded territories of the xʷməθkʷəy̓əm (Musqueam), səlilwətaɬ (Tsleil-Waututh), and Sḵwx̱wú7mesh (Squamish)
